GeneDef.label: eternal slumber
GeneDef.description: Grants the core flux need — the Necron equivalent of deathrest. Core flux depletes while the body is active and must be restored in a stasis crypt, monolith, or compatible suspension.

GeneDef.label: reanimation protocol
GeneDef.description: When Necrons sustain critical damage they enter Reanimation Protocol instead of dying. This allows them to self-repair and rise again as long as their two cores are intact.

GeneDef.label: body degradation
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have undergone Biotransference and are now composed of living metal called necrodermis. As a result they require a constant supply of necrodermis to maintain their body.

GeneDef.label: lifeless
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are dead emotionally and are incapable of experiencing passions; This is due to a genetic imperfection that affects their ability to process emotions.

GeneDef.label: slow advancement
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene experience a significant slowdown in their work speed; This is due to a genetic imperfection that affects their ability to process information and perform tasks efficiently.

GeneDef.label: hatred for the living
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have an innate hatred for the living. This hatred varies from clinical indifference to obsessive, omnicidal rage depending on the individual's mindset or their specific dynasty.

GeneDef.label: apparel incompatible
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are restricted from wearing apparel. Whether it's a static frame or fixed exoskeleton, these individuals cannot wear any apparel.

GeneDef.label: emissary
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a natural aptitude for diplomacy and social interaction; This allows them to engage in negotiations and social interactions with a higher degree of success.

GeneDef.label: bodyguard
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are melee specialists; They cannot equip ranged weapons but have a 15% bonus to dodge and don't lose experience in the melee skill.

GeneDef.label: incapable of work
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are incapable of performing work. They are unable to engage in any form of labor or activity that requires critical thinking or physical effort.

GeneDef.label: low born
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are genetically imperfect and thus considered lowborn. They do not possess free will and do not have the mental capacity to desire comfort, recreation, or beautiful surroundings.

GeneDef.label: low born (flayer-cursed)
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are genetically imperfect and thus considered lowborn. They do not possess free will and do not have the mental capacity to desire comfort, recreation, or beautiful surroundings.\n\nUnlike other lowborn Necrons, the Flayer curse leaves a phantom hunger that cannot be suppressed — an echo of the organic body lost to Biotransference. The mind is too consumed by the curse to perform directed labor.

GeneDef.label: instability
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene stutter when they are staggered, the lock-up results in increased stagger duration.

GeneDef.label: sharpshooter
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a natural aptitude for precision shooting and receive a bonus to shooting accuracy.

GeneDef.label: workflow
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are specialized workers and work with steady, chilling consistency, granting them a bonus to work speed.

GeneDef.label: recall memories
GeneDef.description: Biotransference did not erase the organic self — it left it behind as a debt. Carriers of this gene are haunted by their former lives: phantom sensations, the faces of those long dead, warmth the metal body can never replicate.\n\nThis is Soul-Debt. It accumulates slowly and quietly, and when the ledger comes due, The Sorrow takes hold entirely — plunging the carrier into immersive recollection until the crisis passes.

GeneDef.label: etheric science
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a natural aptitude for Technomancy, allowing them to manipulate etheric energy. \n\nThis gene grants the carrier the ability to manipulate the void to cast spells and use etheric artifacts.

GeneDef.label: noble ego
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene possess a timeless sense of superiority and mental rigidity. Gene holders possess a commanding presence and zero capacity for the petty doubts of "lessers."

li.label: noble ego
li.description: I hail from a lineage of greatness and superiority; This realm is beneath me.

GeneDef.label: royalty
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene hail from "crown worlds" and have been granted royal status by dynastic decree.\n\n Royals emerge with full intellect, memories, and personalities intact; They are immortal, calculating, and powerful.

GeneDef.label: techno-interface
GeneDef.description: The gene carrier's mind is embedded with a specialized interface that allows it to function as a localized node for the dynastic hive-mind. \n\n Carriers of this gene possess a Command Protocol.

GeneDef.label: command node
GeneDef.description: The gene carrier's mind is embedded with a specialized transmitter that allows it to emit "interstitial carrier waves" for interfacing with Canoptek constructs. \n\n Carriers of this gene possess a Control Node.

GeneDef.label: ancestral hubris
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene possess an arrogance perfected by the absolute masters of the dynasties - an ego so dense and unyielding that mere existence outside of their domain is unbearable.

li.label: ancestral hubris
li.description: My genetic sequence carries the echoes of ancient kings and star-striding conquerors. Existing in this menial realm is an insult to my being.

GeneDef.label: social matrix
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene possess an advanced social matrix — internal engram-routing hardware enabling nuanced communication and diplomatic processing beyond the basic vox-emission of lowborn Necrons.

GeneDef.label: nobility
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are part of the highest echelons of the dynasties. \n\nNobles emerge with full intellect, memories, and personalities intact; They are eternal, tactical, and vigilant.

li.label: Dysphorakh
li.description: Sixty million years ago, Biotransference preserved this Necron's neural engrams in living metal — but it could not erase the ghost of what they were. The mind still maps to lungs that no longer draw breath, to a stomach long since dissolved, to skin stripped away in the process. Dysphorakh is the cascading phantom-biological condition that haunts them: drowning in lungs that are not there, starving in a body with no hunger to satisfy, buried alive inside their own frame.\n\nIn its most severe form, Dysphorakh becomes the Flaying Curse — the obsession that turns a Necron warrior into one of the Flayed Ones, draped in biological trophies in a futile attempt to feel alive again.

GeneDef.label: Dysphorakh
GeneDef.description: The phantom-biological condition unique to Necrons who never fully suppressed the organic memory of their pre-Biotransference body. Episodes of suffocation, hunger, and sensory horror cycle unpredictably. In severe cases, the Flaying Curse takes hold.
